task.description: Type C design for ISS-0673. Write src/design/ISS-0673-dual-schema-drop.md. The fix: add a new migration (e.g. GBL-142_iss0673_drop_dual_schema_shadows.sql) that drops all 10 duplicate tables from tenant_default (they are GLOBAL/PLATFORM tables, not per-tenant). Specify: the exact DROP TABLE IF EXISTS statements for each of the 10 tables (event_payload_store, events_ephemeral, events_ephemeral_2026_08/09/10, plat_correlation_cursor, plat_effect_completion, plat_event_idempotency, plat_partition_catalog, plat_partition_maintenance_run_log) within the context of schema_name='tenant_default' or 'tenant_*' schemas. Also specify: (1) how to scope the migration DROP to only affect tenant_default (not public) using SET search_path or explicit schema qualification. (2) Whether lint_migration_schema.py needs updates. (3) Update to docs/anti-patterns.md if the root cause reveals a new anti-pattern variant.

result.summary: REWORK 1/3 — corrected design for ISS-0673. ORCH OQ-1 resolution applied: all 8 tables reclassified as PER_TENANT (stray copies in public). GBL-142 redesigned as single DO block dropping all 8 from public (GBL-141 Step 1 pattern; no tenant loop; IF current_schema() != 'public' guard). Source patches 1145/1146/1148 redesigned from -- scope: public to DO $$ early-return guard (IF current_schema() = 'public' THEN RETURN), matching 1147 pattern exactly. OQ-1 and OQ-3 closed. Anti-pattern entry updated.
